purpose: Teach: 原始/平面/増進/傷害/放火/脅し/蔓延/肝臓

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、原始的な勘ではなくデータで判断しろ
lines.en: At this company, we make decisions based on data, not gut instinct.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Measured cadence. No room for negotiation. Sits back slightly after speaking, already moving to the next point.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。提案書は平面図も添付します
lines.en: Understood. We'll attach floor plans to the proposal document.
lines.style: Efficient, note-taking tone. Quick affirmation at the start. Professional pace, neither rushed nor dragging. Voice stays steady and ready for the next instruction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の健康増進を経営課題と捉えろ
lines.en: This company needs to treat employee health as a core business priority.
lines.style: Formal declaration. Slight emphasis on 'core business priority' — weight behind the words. Measured tempo. He means this as a directive, not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。職場の傷害事故を未然防止します
lines.en: Understood. We'll prevent workplace injuries before they happen.
lines.style: Steady confirmation. Lean slightly forward, showing engagement. Clear enunciation on the commitment. Breathe slightly between 'prevent' and 'workplace injuries'.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社用車の放火対策も検討しろ
lines.en: We also need a countermeasure plan for vehicle security threats.
lines.style: Measured addition to the list. Slight pause before 'vehicle security threats' — he's thinking through the implications. Not casual, but not alarmist either.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員への脅しまがいの言動を禁じます
lines.en: Understood. We'll prohibit any threatening or coercive conduct toward staff.
lines.style: Firm affirmation. Clear, deliberate speech on 'prohibit' — showing he takes this seriously. Voice stays level and professional. Not defensive, just committed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、感染症の社内蔓延を未然防止しろ
lines.en: We must prevent disease transmission from spreading within the company.
lines.style: Formal authority. Slight emphasis on 'must.' Composed delivery — this is another non-negotiable priority. Pause before the next directive begins.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の肝臓検診の補助も検討します
lines.en: Understood. We'll also look into subsidizing liver health screenings for employees.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slight warmth here — showing concern for staff welfare. Even pacing, but the tone carries sincerity underneath the professionalism. Closing statement of the meeting.
